fundamental.summary: RL shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and faces elevated volatility risk with earnings in 10 days.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with mild greed; insufficient data for directional conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 185 crisis regime, FOMC in 2 days) combined with earnings binary in 10 days creates severe risk environment for Consumer Discretionary sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA 50/200 bullish crossover with price above SMA-200 and ADX trending confirmation provides solid intermediate trend structure for swing entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme macro stress (VIX crisis, inverted yield curve, FOMC in 2 days), imminent earnings binary (10 days), zero fundamental support, RSI-21 overbought, and weak momentum confirmation (OBV, PSAR false) create unacceptable risk/reward for discretionary entry.
